title: Wholesale CPG Account Onboarding: Coordinate Sales, Finance, and Operations
summary: An onboarding workflow tracks payer, terms and ship-to approvals across HubSpot, NetSuite and Gmail before a wholesale account takes its first order.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Treat wholesale onboarding as a sequence of owned decisions: identify the legal buyer, approve commercial and finance terms, confirm delivery details, and activate the account for ordering. Sync the shared account context first, then use a workflow to track missing evidence and approvals. A completed CRM form does not establish an approved ERP customer.


Explore the complete[consumer packaged goods integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg) for the systems and processes around this guide.
